integrity: The result contains a complete written perturbation and crossing proof. Standalone symbolic and trajectory checks are finite supplements, not independent validation. Historical priority remains provisional.
limitations: One explicit threshold model, sufficiently small forcing amplitudes, same initial coexistence state; potential Filippov continuation nonuniqueness at tangencies; no claim for smooth regularization or arbitrary models.
title: Frequency-selective extinction from a strictly overdamped predator–prey node
